title: デビュー戦の後に・ディスカッション

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The night after the race, Biwa Hayahide asks that we review her performance, so we start looking through it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she sits there analyzing the footage, it's clear that she's preoccupied with thoughts of her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creating an equation to beat Narita Brian will be a herculean task. The best thing I can do to help is give her practical experience by pitting her against strong opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this in mind, we set our sights on the Asahi Hai F.S., a junior G1 race.
